specs.authoredModuleSummary: Tag-contract defines and validates the per-component tag contract used to determine ownership, node classification, descriptions, and prop listings for design system components, raising an error when a module lacks a contract.
declarationDocs: The props every component export takes from a tag, read from its TypeScript Props type.
specs.description: `tag-contract.mjs` — Tag-contract. Called from `«build-pieces».tagsOf`, and possibly from places the call graph cannot see. `readContract` builds `isOwn`, `readContract` builds `isNode`, `readContract` builds `describe` and `readContract` builds `propsOf`, and no requirement here is about what runs inside them. Can fail: “`readContract` can fail with the error "No module for".” 1 requirement: 1 violated. 2 stated failures.
